avis.texte: If youre looking for a fun, unique mask to bring your skin back to life, this is the mask for you. Once its rubbed into the skin, the formula begins to bubble up and lather into a rich foam, and doesn't dry skin out. It leaves skin feeling hydrated, looking brighter, and feeling refreshed. Gifted by Dr brandt

When it is initially applied, the texture of the mask reminds me of a milky serum. As it activates on the face, it shifts into a lightweight foam that produces bubbles. There is a slight tingling that occurs during this transformation, but it is not irritating even on my very sensitive skin. Remember to let the mask sit on the skin's surface instead of attempting to massage it in which will halt the foaming process and lessen its effectiveness. After five minutes, the fizzing has subdued and the mask can easily be removed with warm water. There is never any sticky residue left behind. Each time I use this product, my skin looks more luminous and feels softer. This mask has been a twice-weekly special treat for me, but because it is gentle, I could see myself using it daily without any negative side effects. Gifted by Dr. BRANDT.

The Dr. Brandt Oxygen Facial Mask exceeded my expectations. It left my skin feeling soft, refreshed, and visibly brighter after just one use.
